issue.title: Measure fish shell-completion latency and replace the estimate in docs/completion.md
issue.description:
Proposed by phase bead sase-oc.8 (epic sase-oc, shell completion) as a PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP and triaged by that epic's land agent.

GAP: fish is not installed on athena (apt candidate 4.0.2-1, 'Installed: (none)'), so sase-oc.3 and sase-oc.8 could measure zsh and bash end to end but never fish. docs/completion.md's Measured Latency table therefore reads 'not independently measured' in all three fish cells, with a note estimating figures close to bash's because fish uses the same __sase_candidates fast path and has no script-compilation step. tests/completion/test_emit_fish.py covers structure only; there is no fish equivalent of the zsh/bash live-shell smoke tests.

SCOPE: on a host with fish available, install the generated script ('sase completion install fish'), measure script load, warm TAB on a cached kind, and cold TAB on a first fetch, then replace the three placeholder cells and the estimate paragraph in docs/completion.md with real numbers. If the numbers diverge materially from bash's, say why. Optionally add a fish live-shell smoke test alongside tests/completion/test_zsh_smoke.py and test_bash_smoke.py, which already skip cleanly when their shell is absent.

payload.close_reason: Fixed: docs/completion.md's Measured Latency table no longer says 'not independently measured' anywhere. The three fish cells now carry real numbers (script load 27.59 ms, warm TAB 179.81 ms, cold TAB 185.53 ms) and the prose records the method: measured on athena with Debian 'fish, version 4.0.2' from package fish=4.0.2-1, generating the live fish script from the checkout behind a temporary sase shim on PATH. Verified 2026-08-24 at 45806495f.
